issues.description: Constructor parameter mismatch: the problem UML and the template Main expect animals to be constructible with only a name (e.g., Seal("Clarabelle")), and the UML shows Animal with a single attribute 'name: String'. The solution classes (Seal, Pig, Goat) add an extra 'age' attribute and provide constructors like Seal(String name, int age), preventing students from using the single-argument constructors shown in the template Main and contradicting the UML/specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Either update the problem statement/UML and the template Main to include an 'age' attribute and show/require two-argument constructors for animals (name, age), or remove the additional 'age' field from the solution and change the animal constructors to take only a single String name parameter so they match the UML and the example usages in Main.
